summary: LoopX (huangruiteng/loopx) is a Python 3.11+ "control plane" for long-running agent goals, not an agent itself: it keeps goal/todo/quota/evidence state (`loopx` CLI, entrypoint `loopx.entrypoint:main`, zero Python deps, plus a Node >=22.18 TypeScript Effect core it spawns via `--experimental-strip-types`) and delegates every model turn to an external host runtime (Codex CLI, Claude Code, dsh, ...). The only shipped path that runs ONE task headlessly end to end is the benchmark runtime in `benchmark/runtime/` (used for LHTB/SWE-Marathon): the project's installer (`scripts/install-local.sh`) stages a LoopX release plus Codex CLI in the task container, `loopx bootstrap` / `configure-goal` / `todo add` seed a trial-local goal whose P0 todo points at a task document, and `scripts/external_scheduler_worker.py` asks `loopx quota should-run` and, when allowed, runs `benchmark.runtime.worker`, which renders `loopx heartbeat-prompt --thin` and pipes that body into `codex exec --json --sandbox danger-full-access` with an isolated CODEX_HOME whose `config.toml` sets `model_providers.harbor.base_url=$OPENAI_BASE_URL`, `wire_api=$CODEX_WIRE_API`, `env_key=OPENAI_API_KEY`. Inside that Codex session the model calls the `loopx` CLI (claim/update todos, spend quota, refresh state) and edits files in the task cwd. So model traffic is Codex -> OpenAI-compatible endpoint; with `CODEX_WIRE_API=chat` it uses `$PROXY_URL/v1/chat/completions`. (LoopX also has a `DirectModelAdapter` in `loopx/chat_providers.py`, but it is read-only, hard-codes api.openai.com/api.anthropic.com, and only serves the dashboard chat, so it cannot execute a task.)
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ARG LOOPX_PY=3.12
ARG CODEX_VERSION=latest

# Only what is missing from a Debian/Ubuntu base; never touch the base python/node.
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git bash xz-utils coreutils \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# --- Self-contained Node.js 24 LTS under /opt/harness/node (LoopX Effect core needs >=22.18; also runs the Codex CLI shim)
RUN set -eux; mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin /opt/harness/node; \
    arch="$(uname -m)"; case "$arch" in x86_64) narch=x64;; aarch64|arm64) narch=arm64;; *) echo "unsupported arch: $arch" >&2; exit 1;; esac; \
    file="$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt | grep -o "node-v24\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*-linux-${narch}\.tar\.xz" | head -n1)"; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/${file}" -o /tmp/node.tar.xz; \
    tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1; rm -f /tmp/node.tar.xz; \
    /opt/harness/node/bin/node --version

# --- Self-contained Python via uv under /opt/harness (LoopX has no third-party deps)
ENV UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/python
RUN curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/bin INSTALLER_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh \
 && /opt/harness/bin/uv python install ${LOOPX_PY} \
 && /opt/harness/bin/uv venv --python ${LOOPX_PY} /opt/harness/venv \
 && /opt/harness/venv/bin/python3 --version

# --- Codex CLI: the model-facing host runtime that LoopX's heartbeat/benchmark path drives
RUN set -eux; export PATH=/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH; \
    npm install -g --prefix /opt/harness/node "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}"; \
    /opt/harness/node/bin/codex --version

# --- LoopX source (build context = repo root) installed with the project's own installer
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN set -eux; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/profile/home /opt/harness/profile/codex-home/skills /opt/harness/profile/releases /opt/harness/profile/man/man1; \
    printf 'export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH\n' > /opt/harness/bash-env; chmod 0644 /opt/harness/bash-env; \
    env HOME=/opt/harness/profile/home \
        CODEX_HOME=/opt/harness/profile/codex-home \
        PATH=/opt/harness/node/bin:/opt/harness/bin:$PATH \
        LOOPX_PYTHON=/opt/harness/venv/bin/python3 \
        LOOPX_PROMOTE_DEFAULT=1 \
        LOOPX_INSTALL_CANARY=0 \
        LOOPX_BIN_DIR=/opt/harness/bin \
        LOOPX_RELEASES_DIR=/opt/harness/profile/releases \
        LOOPX_RELEASE_ID=sandbox-runtime \
        LOOPX_MAN_ROOT=/opt/harness/profile/man \
        LOOPX_MAN_DIR=/opt/harness/profile/man/man1 \
        LOOPX_SHELL_PROFILE=/opt/harness/profile/home/.profile \
        LOOPX_SKILLS_DIR=/opt/harness/profile/codex-home/skills \
        LOOPX_INSTALL_SLASH_COMMANDS=0 \
        LOOPX_INSTALL_OPENCODE=0 \
        LOOPX_INSTALL_CLAUDE=0 \
        LOOPX_SKILL_DEDUPE_OTHER_ROOT=0 \
        LOOPX_INSTALL_REVALIDATE_EXTENSIONS=0 \
        bash /opt/harness/src/scripts/install-local.sh; \
    test -x /opt/harness/bin/loopx; \
    test -d /opt/harness/profile/codex-home/skills; \
    chmod -R a+rX /opt/harness; \
    chmod -R a+rwX /opt/harness/profile

# Only the harness bin dir goes on the global PATH (loopx, uv). The private node/codex dir is
# added inside the run/check commands so the task image's own node is never shadowed.
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
run_command:
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH
export BASH_ENV=/opt/harness/bash-env
export HOME="${HOME:-/tmp}"
export LOOPX_PYTHON=/opt/harness/venv/bin/python3
PY=/opt/harness/venv/bin/python3
LOOPX_CLI=/opt/harness/bin/loopx
OUT="${LOOPX_SANDBOX_OUT:-/out}"; mkdir -p "$OUT" 2>/dev/null || { OUT=/tmp/loopx-out; mkdir -p "$OUT"; }
ROOT="$OUT/loopx"; mkdir -p "$ROOT/control" "$ROOT/runtime" "$ROOT/codex-home" "$OUT/wakes"
PROJECT="$PWD"
REG="$ROOT/control/registry.json"; RR="$ROOT/runtime"
GOAL=sandbox-goal; AGENT=sandbox-agent
TASK_DOC="$ROOT/control/task.md"
printf '# Current task\n\n%s\n' "$TASK" > "$TASK_DOC"
lx() { "$LOOPX_CLI" --format json --registry "$REG" --runtime-root "$RR" "$@"; }
# Trial-local goal, agent, authority scope and the seeded P0 todo (same sequence as benchmark/runtime/harbor.py)
lx bootstrap --project "$PROJECT" --goal-id "$GOAL" --objective "Complete the current task through validated LoopX Todos." --goal-doc "$TASK_DOC" --adapter-kind read_only_project_map_v0 --adapter-status connected-read-only --write-scope '**' --no-global-sync > "$OUT/bootstrap.json" || { cat "$OUT/bootstrap.json"; exit 1; }
lx configure-goal --goal-id "$GOAL" --registered-agent "$AGENT" --boundary-authority-scope '**' --boundary-authority-source sandbox-task-workspace --boundary-authority-decision-id sandbox-workspace --execution-replan-after-todos 3 --agent-work-mode "$AGENT=active" --execute > "$OUT/configure-goal.json" || { cat "$OUT/configure-goal.json"; exit 1; }
lx todo add --goal-id "$GOAL" --role agent --text "[P0] Execute the task. Read the exact current task from $TASK_DOC; inspect the workspace, implement and validate it, and create bounded successor Todos for remaining work." --task-class advancement_task --action-kind benchmark_task --claimed-by "$AGENT" --status open --execute > "$OUT/todo-add.json" || { cat "$OUT/todo-add.json"; exit 1; }
# Environment consumed by benchmark.runtime.worker (heartbeat mode: loopx heartbeat-prompt --thin -> codex exec)
export PYTHONPATH=/opt/harness/src LOOPX_CLI LOOPX_REGISTRY="$REG" LOOPX_RUNTIME_ROOT="$RR" LOOPX_GOAL_ID="$GOAL" LOOPX_AGENT_ID="$AGENT" LOOPX_PROJECT="$PROJECT" LOOPX_TASK_DOC="$TASK_DOC" LOOPX_WAKE_LOG_DIR="$OUT/wakes" LOOPX_CODEX_HOME="$ROOT/codex-home" LOOPX_SHARED_SKILLS=/opt/harness/profile/codex-home/skills LOOPX_EXECUTION_MODE=heartbeat LOOPX_TASK_ENTRY=seeded-todo LOOPX_ITERATION_CONTEXT=fresh LOOPX_CODEX_SANDBOX=danger-full-access LOOPX_VALIDATION_COMMAND_JSON='[]' CODEX_BIN=/opt/harness/node/bin/codex
export MODEL_NAME="${MODEL_NAME:-gpt-5}" REASONING_EFFORT="${REASONING_EFFORT:-high}" CODEX_WIRE_API="${CODEX_WIRE_API:-chat}"
TOTAL="${LOOPX_SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SEC:-3600}"
export LOOPX_CODEX_TURN_TIMEOUT_SEC="${LOOPX_CODEX_TURN_TIMEOUT_SEC:-1800}"
export LOOPX_PHASE_DEADLINE_EPOCH=$(( $(date +%s) + TOTAL ))
wakes=0; fails=0; rc=0
while [ "$wakes" -lt "${LOOPX_SANDBOX_MAX_WAKES:-20}" ]; do
  left=$(( LOOPX_PHASE_DEADLINE_EPOCH - $(date +%s) ))
  if [ "$left" -le 160 ]; then echo "status=budget_exhausted" | tee -a "$OUT/scheduler.log"; break; fi
  line="$(timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30 "$left" "$PY" /opt/harness/src/scripts/external_scheduler_worker.py --cli-bin "$LOOPX_CLI" --registry "$REG" --runtime-root "$RR" --runtime-profile generic_cli --goal-id "$GOAL" --agent-id "$AGENT" --state-file "$ROOT/control/scheduler-state.json" --wake-cmd "exec $PY -m benchmark.runtime.worker" --wake-timeout-seconds $(( LOOPX_CODEX_TURN_TIMEOUT_SEC + 150 )) --quota-timeout-seconds 30 --error-backoff-seconds 15 --once 2>&1)"; rc=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$line" | tee -a "$OUT/scheduler.log"
  case "$line" in
    *"status=should_run wake_ok"*) wakes=$((wakes+1)); fails=0; continue ;;
    *"status=should_run wake_failed"*) wakes=$((wakes+1)); fails=$((fails+1)); [ "$fails" -ge 3 ] && break; sleep 15; continue ;;
    *) break ;;
  esac
done
lx status --goal-id "$GOAL" > "$OUT/final-status.json" 2>&1 || true
echo "loopx sandbox run finished: wakes=$wakes last_rc=$rc"
[ "$wakes" -gt 0 ] && exit 0
exit "$rc"
check_command: export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH; loopx --help >/dev/null && codex --version && loopx --format json doctor --installation-only && /opt/harness/venv/bin/python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/harness/src'); import benchmark.runtime.worker, benchmark.runtime.codex; print('worker import ok')"
notes:
What runs: the project's own benchmark execution path (benchmark/runtime/worker.py + scripts/external_scheduler_worker.py, "heartbeat" mode with a seeded todo), reproduced without Harbor. Sequence per run: task text -> $OUT/loopx/control/task.md; `loopx bootstrap`, `configure-goal`, `todo add` create trial-local state (registry/runtime under /out/loopx, plus LoopX's own project files inside the task cwd, e.g. .loopx/); then a loop of scheduler ticks: `loopx quota should-run --runtime-profile generic_cli` and, while it says should_run, one wake = `loopx heartbeat-prompt --thin` body piped into `codex exec --json --skip-git-repo-check --sandbox danger-full-access --cd <task dir> -`. The loop stops as soon as LoopX's scheduler hint says wait/stop, after LOOPX_SANDBOX_MAX_WAKES wakes, after 3 consecutive failed wakes, or at the LOOPX_SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SEC deadline (worker reserves 160 s for settlement, like the benchmark). Exit 0 if at least one wake ran.

Model routing: worker.py writes CODEX_HOME/config.toml with model_provider "harbor" -> base_url=$OPENAI_BASE_URL, wire_api=$CODEX_WIRE_API, env_key=OPENAI_API_KEY; CODEX_WIRE_API=chat makes Codex use $PROXY_URL/v1/chat/completions (the proxy has no Responses API). MODEL_NAME is passed through unchanged (any name is fine; proxy substitutes). REASONING_EFFORT must be a value the installed Codex accepts (high is safe). Codex web_search is disabled and native Goals/memories are off in that config, as in the benchmark.

Outputs under /out: wakes/<turn-id>/{stdout.jsonl (codex --json events), stderr.log, receipt.json}, sessions/ (Codex native session JSONL copied after each wake), scheduler.log, bootstrap/configure-goal/todo-add/final-status JSON, and loopx/{control,runtime,codex-home} state.

Install notes: the overlay never touches the base python/node. Node 24 LTS tarball -> /opt/harness/node (resolved from nodejs.org latest-v24.x at build), uv-managed CPython 3.12 venv -> /opt/harness/venv, Codex CLI via `npm -g --prefix /opt/harness/node @openai/codex` (ARG CODEX_VERSION, default latest because worker.py's config keys such as features.goals / unified_exec / web_search need a recent Codex), LoopX installed by scripts/install-local.sh into /opt/harness/profile/releases with /opt/harness/bin/loopx symlink and workflow skills in /opt/harness/profile/codex-home/skills (prepare_codex_home requires them). The installer runs `loopx doctor --installation-only` as its own post-install check (no model call). Debian's /etc/profile resets PATH in `bash -lc`, so the run/check commands re-export PATH and BASH_ENV=/opt/harness/bash-env restores it for the login shells Codex uses for tool calls (same trick as benchmark/LHTB).

Alternatives considered and rejected: `loopx turn run-once --host codex-cli` (single governed turn; also Codex-based, requires a validation command) and `--host dsh` (needs deepseek-harness-sdk and DSH credentials); Claude Code is not a run-once host. Anthropic messages API is therefore not usable for this harness; api_style is openai.
